notes.title: Demo Update v0.4
notes.notes: [list][*][p]New starting point in the city with a new garage.[/p][/*][*][p]Engine completely remade from scratch.[/p][/*][*][p]Paint spray for parts and the car.[/p][/*][*][p]New parts added.[/p][/*][*][p]Keybinding system added.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved door interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]New way to adjust idle and carburetor mixture.[/p][/*][*][p]Various bugs fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added wrenches to tighten or loosen car bolts.
[*] The engine can now break if overstrained.
[*] The engine can seize if the temperature gets too high or due to lack of oil.
[*] Improved engine idle, making it more realistic.
[*] Improved engine start-up, making it more realistic.
[*] Increased the collision size of race checkpoints to prevent missing them when passing nearby.
[*] Added an outline to interactive objects.
[*] The race countdown has been increased from 3 to 5 seconds.
[*] Air now helps cool the engine if the radiator has no fan. Removing the hood also affects temperature.
[*] If internal engine parts are damaged, the engine may burn oil.
[*] Bug fixes.
[*] Small gameplay improvements.
[*] New commands added, available in the menu or the game folder.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
[list]  
[*] Changes to the main menu.  
[*] Modifications to the game map.  
[*] Implemented street races.  
[*] Added switch for garage lights.

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Implemented the fuel system, including the fuel tank and pump.
[*] Added new sound effects.
[*] Screws inserted into some parts.
[*] Applied new textures to certain parts.
[*] Integrated brake fluid lines (visual only, no interaction at the moment).
[*] Fixed collision on the highway roads.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.1
notes.notes:
[list] 
[*] New car entry and exit system, fixing bugs from the previous method (possible future changes).
[*] Fixed cylinder head gasket not appearing correctly on the block when installed.
[*] Carburetor mixture and idle adjustment error fixed.
[*] Increased durability of brake pads and discs.
[*] Car headlight intensity increased for better visibility.
[*] Fixed gear ratio error, which was stuck at 1 for all gears.
[*] Player can now jump.
[*] Improved mechanic cart movement.
[*] Steering sensitivity adjustment now available in settings.
[*] Fixed position of the driveshafts.
[*] Fixed shock absorber rotation.
[*] Improved jack usage, making it easier to lift the car.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[*] New command to repair damaged parts. To use, press "F1" and type "fix-all-parts" (parts must be mounted on the car for the command to work).
[/list]

notes.title: Update Demo v0.1.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Performance has been significantly improved, making the game about 4 times lighter than the previous version. (Not 100% optimized)
[*] Minimum and recommended requirements have been adjusted.
[*] The city has been rebuilt from scratch (still in progress).
[*] Map expansion (not finished).
[*] The player now starts in an urban area.
[*] Visual issues with the suspension have been fixed.
[*] New parts have been added for the engine.
[*] Cooling (water) and lubrication (oil) systems have been implemented, with leaks in case of engine issues.
[*] Head gasket added, can break and affect engine performance.
[*] Full exhaust system now affects engine sound and power.
[*] Ability to adjust the carburetor mixture and idle, directly impacting power.
[*] Engine failures if a cylinder doesn’t work correctly, causing RPM fluctuations.
[*] Engine requires specific parts installed to work (not finished).
[*] Car physics have been improved.
[*] Player movement has been adjusted and improved.
[*] Functional dashboard with indicators working properly.
[*] Car seats have been added.
[*] Automatic clutch option added to ease driving.
[*] The game has been translated into the following languages: Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, French, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
[/list]

This will be the last major update for the demo. From now on, only small updates with bug fixes and improvements will be released. Our next step is to start developing early access, bringing more content and refinements to the game. Stay tuned for more updates!
